$about: Ranges an export must land in, widened from the measured examples (see examples/*/profile.json). Run: node ../kit/measure.mjs export.mp4 --sample-every 15 --out p.json && node ../kit/check.mjs p.json targets.json

durationSeconds.why: long form; the example runs 51 min

shots.longestSeconds.why: at least one location runs as one unbroken take; the example's longest is ~15.5 min

picture.ylow.why: lifted, faded blacks; the example averages 43

picture.yhigh.why: rolled highlights, no clipped sky; the example averages 202

loudness.integratedLufs.why: natural, unpushed speech; the example is −27.1, aim higher for phones
